name: Shadow Lockpick
body:
School illusion (shadow) [shadow]; Level adept 1, inquisitor 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 0 ft.

Effect one shadow thieves tools
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will disbelief (if interacted with); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Drawing upon the Plane of Shadow, you shape thieves’ tools into your hands. At 5th level, the thieves’ tools become masterwork.
